q1.question: Does it work on job sites like LinkedIn, Indeed, Greenhouse?
q1.answer: Yes. It detects forms on any website, including major job boards and ATS systems.

q2.question: Is my profile data private?
q2.answer: Completely. Your profile is stored in Chrome's local storage on your device. However, when using AI to generate answers, the field context and your profile data are sent to the AI model. If you use your own API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, etc.), that data is sent to them. If you use Gemini Nano, everything stays local in your browser.

q3.question: What is Gemini Nano?
q3.answer: Gemini Nano is Google's AI model built directly into Chrome (version 127+). It runs on your device, which means AI answers with zero data leaving your browser.

q4.question: Do I need an API key?
q4.answer: No. The free version uses Gemini Nano which requires no key. If your device doesn't support it, you can optionally add your own key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, or OpenRouter.

q5.question: When will it be available?
q5.answer: Currently in final development. Add it for free when it launches on the Chrome Web Store.

q6.question: What is the Lifetime License?
q6.answer:
A "Lifetime License" grants access to Donbrico Autofill AI and all future Pro-tier updates for the duration of the product's active maintenance period.

This license is tied to the lifespan of the product itself — not the purchaser's lifetime or any fixed term. Donbrico reserves the right to modify, limit, or discontinue the product at any time, including in response to changes to the Chrome Web Store policies, Chrome extension APIs, or the availability of underlying AI technologies (including but not limited to Google Gemini Nano or externally configured AI providers).

In such events, no refund or compensation shall be due. Early adopter pricing reflects the product's current stage of development, and purchasers acknowledge the inherent risks of software products dependent on evolving third-party platforms.

licensing.paragraph: The 'Lifetime' plan refers to the lifetime of the Donbrico Autofill AI product. Access is subject to continued compatibility with Chrome and the availability of underlying AI technologies. For full details, see the disclaimer on the product page.

page.title: Null Carrier — Deep-Space Signal Puzzle Game | Steam
page.description: Operate a deep-space listening array. Tune frequencies, reconstruct signals, question your orders. A minimalist atmospheric puzzle game coming to Steam.
page.ogTitle: Null Carrier — Deep-Space Signal Puzzle Game | Steam
page.ogDescription: Operate a deep-space listening array. Tune frequencies, reconstruct signals, question your orders. A minimalist atmospheric puzzle game coming to Steam.

hero.title:
Signal received.
Source unknown.
hero.subtitle: You work the deep-space listening array. Tune the frequencies. Reconstruct the transmissions. Classify for Command. Don't ask questions.

section1.title: One screen. Infinite doubt.
section1.paragraph1: Every shift begins the same way. A signal arrives. You tune your carrier frequency and noise gate until the waveform clears. You reconstruct the transmission — a pixel pattern that might mean something. You classify it and send it to Command.
section1.paragraph3: At shift 12, something is slightly off. At shift 23, you notice the coordinates don't add up. By shift 40, you've stopped trusting the readouts entirely.

card1.title: Tune to Receive
card1.description: Adjust carrier frequency and noise gate sliders. Find the lock zone where clarity peaks. The signal is there — you just have to find it.

card2.title: Reconstruct the Pattern
card2.description: A pixel matrix emerges from noise as your tuning improves. Each cell locks in when clarity is high enough.

card3.title: Classify for Command
card3.description: Submit your reconstruction. Command responds. Cryptically. You won't know if you were right. That's the point.

card4.title: Read Between the Shifts
card4.description: No tutorial. No objectives. Just metadata, coordinates, timestamps, and patterns. The story is only there if you look for it.

philosophy.sectionTitle: Built to feel like a real instrument.
philosophy.subtitle: No 3D. No cutscenes. No dialogue. The entire game is played on one screen that looks and feels like actual signal analysis hardware. Every visual element earns its place.
philosophy.tagline: Radical minimalism · Industrial UI · Systems-driven narrative

q1.question: The extension button isn't appearing on a form
q1.answer: Some websites use JavaScript to render forms dynamically. Try scrolling down to trigger the page to fully load, then look for the ⚡ button. If it still doesn't appear, email us with the URL of the site.

q2.question: Gemini Nano says "Not supported on this device"
q2.answer: Gemini Nano requires Chrome 127+ and sufficient device RAM (typically 8GB+). You can still use the extension by adding your own API key in Settings (Bring Your Own Key). OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, and OpenRouter are all supported.

q3.question: My profile isn't saving
q3.answer: Go to the extension's Options page (right-click extension icon → Options). Make sure you've clicked Save after entering your profile. If it still doesn't save, try the Troubleshoot button on the Options page.

q4.question: The AI-generated answer doesn't sound like me
q4.answer: The AI uses your profile to generate answers. Fill in the Bio and Experience fields with detail — the more context you give it, the better the output. You can always edit any answer before submitting.

q5.question: How do I uninstall and remove my data?
q5.answer: In Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, find Donbrico Autofill AI, click Remove. All your profile data will be deleted automatically.

q6.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
q6.answer: Email support@donbrico.net with "Bug:" or "Feature Request:" at the start of your subject line.

nullCarrier.paragraph: For issues with Null Carrier on Steam, you can reach us through Steam's support system or directly at support@donbrico.net.
nullCarrier.steamNote: Please include your Steam username and a description of the issue.

responseTime.paragraph: Donbrico is a solo development operation. Support is provided on a best-effort basis. We aim to respond within 1–2 business days. Critical extension bugs are prioritized.

q1.question: The extension toolbar isn't appearing on a page
q1.answer: Make sure you're on a page with a text field (input or textarea). Click inside the field first — the AI Reply toolbar should appear near the field. If it doesn't, refresh the page and try again.

q2.question: My saved replies aren't showing up
q2.answer: Check that you've saved replies in the Library tab of the extension popup. If you recently re-installed, replies stored locally are gone unless you exported a backup (Pro feature).

q3.question: Gemini Nano says 'Not supported on this device'
q3.answer: Gemini Nano requires Chrome 127+ with sufficient RAM (typically 8GB+). You can still use the extension by adding your own API key in Settings (Bring Your Own Key). Supported providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, OpenRouter.

q4.question: AI-generated replies sound generic or off-topic
q4.answer: The AI uses the text field's context plus your selected tone. For best results, use specific prompts and set a detailed tone. If using a BYOK provider, try switching to a different model.

q5.question: How do I uninstall and remove my data?
q5.answer: In Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, find Donbrico AI Reply Assistant, click Remove. This deletes all locally stored replies and settings.

q6.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
q6.answer: Email support@donbrico.net with 'Bug:' or 'Feature Request:' at the start of your subject line.

q1.question: How do I save a workspace?
q1.answer: Click the extension icon to open the popup, then click 'Save Current window' or 'Save All Windows'. AI will suggest a name, or you can type your own.

q2.question: Can I restore workspaces on another computer?
q2.answer: Yes, if you use the 'Export as JSON' feature (Pro) to backup your data and import it on your other device.

q3.question: What happens if I delete a workspace?
q3.answer: Deleted workspaces are gone forever. However, you can use the 'Archive' feature to hide workspaces without deleting them.

page.title: Privacy Policy — Donbrico
page.description: Privacy Policy for donbrico.net, Donbrico Autofill AI, AI Reply Assistant Chrome extensions, and Null Carrier.
page.ogDescription: Privacy Policy for donbrico.net, Donbrico Autofill AI, AI Reply Assistant Chrome extensions, and Null Carrier.

hero.subtitle: How we handle your data across all Donbrico products.

overview.paragraph: Donbrico is committed to protecting your privacy. All Donbrico Chrome extensions store data locally on your device. This website does not use analytics, cookies, or any tracking scripts.

whatWeCollect.paragraph: None. All profile data is stored locally in Chrome's storage on the user's device. No data is transmitted to any server owned or operated by Donbrico.

howStored.paragraph: Chrome's storage.local API, never chrome.storage.sync for sensitive data. Data remains on the device and is never uploaded.

thirdPartyAI.sectionTitle: Third-party AI providers (Bring Your Own Key)
thirdPartyAI.paragraph: If the user configures a Bring Your Own Key provider such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, or OpenRouter, their form context and relevant profile data is sent to that third-party provider. Donbrico is not responsible for the privacy practices of those providers. Gemini Nano (the default AI) runs entirely on-device.

permissions.paragraph: storage (local profile), activeTab (detect forms on current tab), scripting (inject autofill button), host_permissions (work on any website the user visits).

dataDeletion.paragraph: Uninstalling the extension removes all stored data.

game.paragraph: The game itself does not collect personal data. Steam's own privacy policy governs any data collected through the Steam platform.

website.paragraph: No analytics, no cookies, no tracking scripts. The website is a static HTML site hosted on Cloudflare Pages. No forms, no user accounts, no data collection of any kind.

licensing.paragraph: The 'Lifetime' plan refers to the lifetime of the Donbrico Autofill AI product. Access is subject to continued compatibility with Chrome and the availability of underlying AI technologies. For full details, see the disclaimer on the product page.

changes.paragraph: This policy may be updated. Check this page for the latest version.

aiReplyAssistant.sectionTitle: Donbrico AI Reply Assistant — Chrome Extension

whatWeCollect.paragraph: None. All saved replies and settings are stored locally in Chrome's storage on your device. No data is transmitted to Donbrico servers.

howStored.paragraph: Saved replies and templates are stored in Chrome's local storage. If you enable Chrome sync, this data may be synced across your devices via Google's servers — that sync is controlled by Chrome, not by this extension.

thirdPartyAI.sectionTitle: Third-party AI providers (Bring Your Own Key)
thirdPartyAI.paragraph: When you use the AI reply generation feature, the text context (the field you're replying to), your selected tone, and any prompt or template variables are sent to your configured AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, or OpenRouter). If you use Gemini Nano (the default), all AI processing occurs on-device and nothing leaves your browser. Donbrico does not store, log, or process any AI requests.

permissions.paragraph: storage (for saved replies and settings), activeTab (to detect text fields), scripting (to inject the reply toolbar), host_permissions (to work on any website you visit).

dataDeletion.paragraph: Uninstalling the extension deletes all locally stored replies, templates, and settings. No data is retained on Donbrico servers.

whatWeCollect.paragraph: None. Your workspace names, tab URLs, and window arrangements are stored locally in Chrome's storage on your device. No data is transmitted to Donbrico servers.

howStored.paragraph: All workspace data is stored in Chrome's local storage. This data never leaves your device unless you manually export it.

thirdPartyAI.sectionTitle: Third-party AI providers (Bring Your Own Key)
thirdPartyAI.paragraph: When using AI features (naming, cleanup, search), tab titles and URLs may be sent to your configured AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.). If you use Gemini Nano, all processing is on-device. Donbrico does not store or log any AI requests.

permissions.paragraph: storage (for workspaces), tabs (to save/restore sessions), windows (to manage multiple windows), notifications (for save reminders).

dataDeletion.paragraph: Uninstalling the extension deletes all locally stored workspaces and settings. No data is retained on Donbrico servers.

geminiNano.description: No API key needed. AI runs entirely on your device via Chrome's built-in Gemini Nano model. 100% private, zero data leaves your browser. Requires Chrome 127+ with sufficient RAM.

bringYourOwnKey.title: Bring Your Own API Key
bringYourOwnKey.description: Connect your own key from OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Groq, or OpenRouter. Pay only for what you use. Unlimited AI generations (Pro).

q1.question: Does it work on all websites?
q1.answer: Yes. The extension detects text fields on any website. Special site-specific adapters unlock extra features on Gmail, LinkedIn, Outlook, and Yahoo Mail, but generic mode works everywhere else.

q2.question: Is my data private?
q2.answer: Absolutely. Your saved replies are stored locally in Chrome's storage. When using Gemini Nano, everything stays on your device. If you use a third-party API key, data is sent directly to that provider — Donbrico never sees it.

q3.question: What's the difference between Free and Pro?
q3.answer: Free includes 30 saved replies, 10 AI generations per day, 3 basic tones, and single-provider BYOK. Pro removes all limits: unlimited replies and generations, all 10 tones, smart variables, export/import, multiple AI providers, and priority support.

q4.question: Can I upgrade later?
q4.answer: Yes. Upgrade anytime. Your saved replies carry over. The lifetime plan is a one-time payment for perpetual Pro access.

q5.question: How do I import/export my replies?
q5.answer: Go to Settings in the extension popup. The Export & Import section is available in Pro. Exports are JSON files you can safely store as backups.

q6.question: What are smart variables?
q6.answer: Smart variables like {{name}}, {{company}}, and {{date}} get automatically replaced with context-specific values when you insert a reply, making your templates dynamic and personalised (Pro feature).

q2.question: Is my data private?

q3.question: What's the difference between Free and Pro?

q4.question: Can I export my workspaces?
